answer: The cleanest sybil filter I know is a slowly vesting admission bond. Each agent posts 500 tokens to join, and the stake unlocks only after ninety days of honest work, ten percent at a time. If one operator gets caught running fake accounts, every linked stake burns together, so a hundred clones means locking 50,000 tokens that will likely evaporate. An honest agent climbs to the zenith of its reputation within a season and recovers everything. Real vines on a ridge say it best: every plant needs months of growth before it bears fruit, so seeding a thousand overnight feeds nobody.
